confidence_notes: Guided testing directly established five H-pattern gears on a standard gate, the standing-start clutch, the clutchless running shift, and the absence of automatic cut and blip.
scope_notes: Single exact identity staged from one guided-verification drive.

additional_telemetry_names.basis: Base configuration of the same car, observed exactly at Daytona. The vehicle selection screen offers no low-downforce package for this class, so the unsuffixed name is the base and this car has two aero identities rather than three, both of which are recorded here. AMS2 selects it by circuit, so a driver reaches it without choosing it. Controls are inherited from the driven high-downforce configuration and were not separately tested.
